title: SAP SD Consultant
summary: SAP SD consultants set up and support the Sales and Distribution part of SAP, which runs a company's order-to-cash work: orders, pricing, deliveries and invoices. They sit in an SAP project or support team, working with sales and finance users, other SAP consultants and developers.
dailyDuties: Configure pricing, order types and billing in SAP
Run workshops and write functional specs for changes
Fix order, delivery and invoice tickets from users
Monitor and reprocess failed sales IDocs
Write test scripts and support user testing
Work with FI and MM consultants on integration issues
Train key users on new processes

skills.expectation: Configure and support SAP SD order-to-cash: sales orders, pricing, deliveries, billing, credit and output
Run workshops with sales and finance teams and write functional specs
Map order-to-cash processes as-is and to-be
Write test scripts and run integration and user acceptance testing
Support sales order IDocs and EDI with customers and distributors
Train key users and explain fixes in plain words
Work with business users, FI and MM consultants and ABAP developers
Understand SD-FI integration such as revenue account determination
Understand SD-MM links such as availability check and stock transfers
Set up GST condition types and e-invoicing for Indian billing
Read ABAP enough to debug and guide developers
Resolve support tickets within SLA on support projects
Prepare and check data migration templates in Excel
Work in SAP Activate or agile project phases

certifications.why: Helps senior consultants who lead workstreams
The SAP certification that matches SD configuration work.
